name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 26, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Joe Barsha, La Mirada Christian Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: VFW Post 9148
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF WOMEN OF THE YEAR IN COMMEMORATION OF WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH – It is recommended the City Council present Lucy Crabb and Michelle Lynch with a recognition plaque for their valuable contributions to the community and for being selected as 2022 Women of the Year.
5.1 Recognition of Women of the Year
5.2
RECOGNITION OF TEEN COMMUNITY EMERGENCY RESPONSE TEAM (CERT) GRADUATES – It is recommended the City Council recognize the Teen Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) graduates and present them with a Certificate of Recognition.
5.2 Recognition of Teen CERT Graduates
5.3
PRESENTATION OF AWARDS TO THE "LOVE A TREE" POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council present a Certificate of Recognition and two general admission day passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center to the "Love a Tree" poster contest winners.
5.3 Love A Tree Poster Contest
5.4
PROCLAMATION FOR PUBLIC SCHOOLS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 2022 as Public Schools Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Norwalk-La Mirada Unified School District Board President Norma Amezcua.
5.4 Proclamation for Public Schools Month
5.5
PROCLAMATION FOR ARBOR DAY – It is recommended the City Council proclaim April 29, 2022 as Arbor Day in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Public Works Director/City Engineer Mark Stowell.
5.5 Proclamation for Arbor Day
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of April 12, 2022 and the regular City Council meeting of April 12, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 4-12-22 SS
7.1 Minutes of 4-12-22 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 26, 2022 in the total amount of $1,940,166.14.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
CITY COUNCIL REQUEST FOR CONFERENCE ATTENDANCE - It is recommended the City Council approve Mayor Eng’s and Councilmember Sarega’s request to attend the California Contract Cities Association’s Annual Seminar.
7.3 City Council Request for Conference Attendance
7.4
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE NEW ONE-TON CAPACITY CHAIN MOTORS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of six new one-ton chain motors from Technology International, Inc. at a cost not to exceed $30,090.00.
7.4 Authorization to Purchase Theatre Chain Motors
7.5
AS-NEEDED TRAFFIC ENGINEERING SERVICES – APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT TO ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL/TECHNICAL SERVICES AGREEMENT TO W.G. ZIMMERMAN ENGINEERING INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING CONSULTING SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal from W.G. Zimmerman Engineering, Inc. for professional consulting services with a budget of $100,000; authorize the City Manager to approve an addendum to the existing On-Call Professional/Technical Services Agreement for professional engineering consulting services to W.G. Zimmerman Engineering, Inc. in the amount of $100,000; and authorize the City Manager to approve an increase to the budget amount up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount and to extend the amendment term one additional year, if required.
7.5 As-Needed Traffic Engineer Services
7.6
APPROVAL FOR SPECIAL EVENT PARKING ON FOSTER ROAD FOR THE JULY 3 INDEPENDENCE CELEBRATION - It is recommended the City Council approve Special Event Parking on the north and south sides of Foster Road between Santa Gertrudes Avenue and Lisburn Place on July 3 from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m.
7.6 Special Event Parking for July 3
7.7
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING March 2022 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending March 2022.
7.7 Investment Report
7.8
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE AND INSTALL A NEW VIDEO NETWORKING SYSTEM AT LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase and installation of a new video networking system for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts from EIDIM Group, Inc. at a cost not to exceed $120,822.43.
7.8 Theatre Video Networking System
7.9
APPROVAL OF USE OF FACILITY - LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT SPECIAL OLYMPICS EVENT AT SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for the use of Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department's Special Olympics fundraising event and waive the staff and facility rental fees in the amount of $1,821 associated with the proposed use.
7.9 Approval of Use of Facility
7.10
APPROVAL OF AN AGREEMENT WITH AT&T FOR WIDE AREA NETWORK (WAN) SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with AT&T for WAN services.
7.10 Agreement with AT&T for WAN Services
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-08 ESTABLISHING UNDERGROUND UTILITY DISTRICT NO. 22-11, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD FROM HUTCHINS DRIVE TO 125' SOUTH OF IMPERIAL HIGHWAY, AND IMPERIAL HIGHWAY FROM 320' WEST OF LA MIRADA BOULEVARD TO 230' EAST OF LA MIRADA BOULEVARD - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as required by law and adopt Resolution No. 22-08 determining the need for the undergrounding of overhead facilities and establishing Underground Utility District No. 22-11.
8.1 Public Hearing and Reso. No. 22-08
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 22-09 APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF A MARKED CONTINENTAL CROSSWALK, ACCOMPANYING SIGNS AND PAVEMENT MARKINGS, AND RECTANGULAR RAPID FLASHING BEACONS ON HILLSBOROUGH DRIVE AT THE COYOTE CREEK BIKEWAY CROSSING - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-09 approving the installation of a marked continental crosswalk, accompanying signs and pavement markings, and Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons on Hillsborough Drive at the Coyote Creek Bikeway Crossing.
9.1 Resolution No. 22-09
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 22-10 ADOPTING A PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 FUNDED BY SB-1: THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-10 adopting a project list for Fiscal Year 2022-23 funded by SB-1 and authorize staff to submit the project list to the California Transportation Commission.
9.2 Resolution No. 22-10
